title: Fed Governor Michael Barr warns AI agents could trigger bank runs in minutes
content: In a speech at an AI event in Italy, Barr said automated financial decisions could overwhelm banks and raises concerns about AI systems bypassing security controls.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 as tech slides ahead of Nvidia earnings
content: ZEC and HYPE led a quiet bounce in altcoins, while Nasdaq futures extended a two-day rout and traders waited on U.S. retail sales.

title: Hackers plant crypto-stealing code on 178 major websites, including HSBC and Ledger
content: An Optimizely signup flaw let an attacker plant address-swapping code on websites including HSBC, the BBC and Ledger. The total stolen remains unknown, and investigators have not linked the attack to AI.

title: Nvidia faces first earnings test without Jensen Huang as AI stocks slide
content: With shares almost 40% below their October peak, Nvidia’s guidance could carry more weight than quarterly results as investors assess its direction without Jensen Huang.

title: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
content: North Korea's TraderTraitor group transferred 34,279 ETH to three new wallets. The funds have not moved again, blockchain investigators say.

title: Google says hackers use AI agents to find and exploit software flaws
content: Google says attackers are using AI agents to find and exploit software flaws automatically, reducing the time organizations have to apply patches.

title: US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
content: Judge Jessica Clarke said the transactions did not involve false promises, but the ruling did not determine whether the brothers’ conduct was ethical or violated other laws.

title: Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
content: Goldman Sachs increased its Ether ETF shares in Q3, bringing its reported holdings to $1.22 billion, while reshuffling its Bitcoin ETF positions.

title: Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to $125K Hyperliquid trading scheme
content: The former Robinhood engineer used confidential information about upcoming Robinhood token listings to trade on Hyperliquid.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Nvidia Board Not Considering Jensen Huang's Return: Report
content: The board is focused on its probe into the ousted co-founder, a source told CNBC, despite Donald Trump and Elon Musk backing his return.

title: Judge Acquits MIT Brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV Case, Ending Prosecution
content: A federal judge ruled prosecutors failed to prove the material misrepresentation needed for wire fraud, a year after a jury deadlocked.

title: Solana Foundation Backs CoinGecko as Crypto Data Giant Eyes Trading
content: CoinGecko has received backing from the Solana Foundation to expand into market intelligence and explore trading.

title: Alibaba's Qwen 4 Max Leads China's AI Agent Race—But You Can't Download It
content: Alibaba's new flagship jumps ahead of Chinese rivals on agent and web design leaderboards, with cheaper API access. The closed model also previews the next generation of open Qwen releases.

title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Trezor Says Customer Data Was Exposed Again
content: A second Trezor shipping partner was breached in three months, exposing buyers' addresses and order details.

title: Bitcoin Price Holds Near $65,000 as Nvidia Turmoil Drags Nasdaq Down 2.5%
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Holds Near $65,000 as Nvidia Turmoil Drags Nasdaq Down 2.5% Bitcoin price held near $65,000 on Monday afternoon, shrugging off a 2.5% Nasdaq slide as Nvidia's board ruled out bringing back Jensen Huang and the dollar hit a 19-month high. This post Bitcoin Price Holds Near $65,000 as Nvidia Turmoil Drags Nasdaq Down 2.5% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Senate Agriculture Committee to Hear Trump’s CFTC Nominees Tuesday
content: Bitcoin Magazine Senate Agriculture Committee to Hear Trump’s CFTC Nominees Tuesday The Senate Agriculture Committee will hear Nathan Anonick and Matthew Rowland on Tuesday, President Trump's bipartisan picks to join CFTC Chairman Michael Selig, currently the agency's only sitting commissioner. This post Senate Agriculture Committee to Hear Trump’s CFTC Nominees Tuesday first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Rob Hamilton: The AI “Black Hole” is Pulling Liquidity Away from Bitcoin
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Rob Hamilton: The AI “Black Hole” is Pulling Liquidity Away from Bitcoin AnchorWatch CEO Rob Hamilton is bullish on Bitcoin in the long run, even as he watches liquidity get pulled toward the Anthropic IPO and the AI trade, which he compares to a black hole. This post Rob Hamilton: The AI “Black Hole” is Pulling Liquidity Away from Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
